formal_statement: Canonical motif compression preserves counterexample status for the compressed witness.
assumptions: accepted compressible motif; compressed witness defined; motif status fields congruent
reason: Too strong without a canonical-motif counterexample-status congruence theorem.

formal_statement: If status is not literally preserved, the compressed object is a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: accepted compression; compressed status remains valid counterexample or reduced obstruction
reason: Lexicographic measure decrease is available, but valid reduced-status transfer remains open.

formal_statement: Canonical motif compression preserves status or reduces to a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: motif congruence; accepted compression; support/canonical measure guard
reason: This is useful but still too strong before counterexample-status congruence closes.

formal_statement: Canonical motif compression preserves status, reduces to a smaller witness, or routes failure to a named blocker/deferred higher-support escape.
assumptions: canonical motif notation; compression semantics; status language; support/canonical measure guard; escape interface
reason: Selected because it formalizes the status branch without hiding the open motif congruence theorem.

formal_statement: Every support-growth witness has full canonical-compression status congruence.
assumptions: arbitrary support-growth witness; complete motif/status congruence; all preservation proofs
reason: Out of scope; would incorrectly promote one operation status proof to a full theorem.
